      "band": "P2",

      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Integrates native Cap'n Proto request cancellation into libmultiprocess and the interface layer. This allows IPC clients to cancel in-flight blocking calls simply by dropping request promises instead of coordinating separate out-of-band interrupt calls."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label and modifies blocking methods in src/interfaces/mining.h and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces out-of-band interrupt() and interruptWait() calls with cancellation arguments on blocking mining interface methods (waitTipChanged, createNewBlock, waitNext). While improving interface ergonomics and eliminating extra round-trips for external consumers like Stratum v2 providers, the change is reasonably deferrable as working interrupt mechanisms already exist."
